name: HH regime-switch 11 — crypto momentum with a VIX-rising risk-off kill-switch (daily)
rationale: MECHANISM (defensive, NOT a return source): pure crypto momentum decayed in the 2024-2025 whipsaw (altcoins -44% peak-to-trough, reversals dominated). The claim is NOT that regime adds return but that a macro risk-off tag lets you SIT OUT the choppy tape where whipsaw fees plus adverse moves eat momentum's Sharpe. Here the kill-switch is a VIX ceiling: only take momentum entries when vix_level is BELOW a fitted calm ceiling (risk is on) AND adx confirms a trend AND ret_Nd is positive. When VIX is elevated we simply do not enter — abstention, not extraction. Exit on trend death (ADX collapse) or a VIX spike above the ceiling (regime turned risk-off mid-trade), or stop/TP/time. This is rated a LOW bar on purpose. DISCONFIRMER: compare gated vs UNGATED momentum on the same asset/period — the VIX veto must raise net-of-fee return AND cut maxDD simultaneously; if it only does one, or just trades less for the same Sharpe, the overlay is cosmetic. Most likely the veto merely removes trades fees already made unprofitable, adding nothing — expect this to die.
catalyst: confirmed crypto trend taken only while equity-vol says risk is on
